text:
sophie: quick async standup for OrchidPay renewal escalation — saw a spike in webhook failures overnight (500s). did initial triage, opened support ticket, and collected traces. suspect retry/backoff logic on their side plus our ingress timing. tagging eng for quick eyes.

ajay: looking now. can you paste the most recent logs + customer request id? also what env (prod/dedicated)?

sophie: prod (hosted). request id: req_0x9f3a. excerpted error: "upstream read timeout after 5s". full trace in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821

matt: CS note — OrchidPay is in final renewal discussions next week. renewal score drops if we cant stabilize webhook delivery. customer willing to accept a maintenance window tonight if it helps.

ajay: thanks. two quick asks: 1) can we extend ingress timeout to 10s as a temporary mitigant? 2) need to confirm our retry behavior for 502/504 from their endpoints. I can patch a config in staging first.

sophie: maintenance window approved: 2200-2300 PST. please flag any fallout.

lina: linking product — if we roll a config change, we should record impact on SLA metric in the rollout notes. also prepare a rollback plan.

ajay: quick test plan: deploy timeout bump to staging, run a replay of failed webhook payloads (~200 requests) using: 
```
for id in $(cat failed_ids.txt); do curl -X POST https://staging.ingress.redwood.internal/webhook -H "X-Req-ID:$id" --data @payload.json; done
```
Collect 95p latency and failure rate.

sophie: I uploaded failed_ids.txt + payload.json to the ticket.

matt: CS action: I'll message the OrchidPay renewal lead (Ben) and confirm they can be in the window. also offer to stand by during the rollout.

ajay: if staging looks good i'll schedule the prod change and add a canary (5% traffic) for 15m before full flip. will post deploy-bot status.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: timeout-config-v2 to staging by ajay. ETA 10m.

sophie: blockers: i) need eng signoff on timeout bump ii) confirm canary metrics dashboard (cost/latency) iii) cs comms drafted for Ben.

ajay: will sign off after staging replay results. assigning self on the ticket.

lina: i'll create a short rollout doc and add it to the ticket (steps + rollback + owners).

matt: i'll draft the comms and drop in the ticket now.

sophie: thanks team. ping here when deploy-bot posts status. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: timeout-config-v2 to staging. logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/deploys/timeout-config-v2

ajay: replay ran — staging 95p latency = 320ms, failures = 0. rolling canary to prod at 15:40 PST (5% traffic). will monitor charts and tag here.

sophie: noted. followups: update renewal playbook with this template, and schedule a quick retro if prod canary hits >1% failure.

matt: acknowledged, will add to renewal notes.

[thread closed for now — will reopen if prod canary alerts]
